recipes.title: GitHub
recipes.authentication: OAuth or documented token; choose the user-owned account
recipes.scope: Read repository issues, PRs and code; writes require separately requested authority
recipes.credentialPolicy: Never include credentials in a preview, prompt, repository or connection URL.

recipes.title: Vercel
recipes.authentication: Host-managed OAuth; verify team/project
recipes.scope: Inspect projects/logs; deployment and environment writes are separate actions
recipes.credentialPolicy: Never include credentials in a preview, prompt, repository or connection URL.

recipes.title: Linear
recipes.authentication: Host-managed OAuth; read scope preferred
recipes.scope: Read issue/project context; do not infer issue creation authority
recipes.credentialPolicy: Never include credentials in a preview, prompt, repository or connection URL.

recipes.title: Notion
recipes.authentication: Use current official host connection instructions
